description.value: Helmcken Falls Holiday Resort is a wilderness resort established in 1952 and situated inside Wells Gray Provincial Park, offering log cabins, chalets, heritage rooms, RV sites, and tent camping across 20 acres of forest. Its central location places guests 15–20 minutes from major park attractions including Helmcken, Dawson, and Spahats Falls. An on-site restaurant and lounge, camping store, and friendly front-desk staff make it a self-contained base for multi-day backcountry touring in one of BC's most spectacular parks.
